decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ Event already captures the code-used $5 commission, referrer recipient, immediate timing, automatic wallet transfer, and unlimited earning claim.
The commission decision does not change the independently defined issuance, recipient, quantity, or lifecycle of referral prize tickets.
Specifying commission trigger, recipient, destination, timing, and earning limit does not alter the NFT mint number's identity, permanence, sharing methods, or display surfaces.
The source decision concerns commission payment when a referral code is used and leaves ticket allocation for mints without a referral code unchanged.

The candidate already records the $5 allocation for a code-used mint; payout recipient, destination, timing, and unlimited earning belong to the separate commission behavior and do not change the revenue split.
The commission details do not change metadata counters, badge visibility, or the referral-code attribute source.
Commission payment semantics do not alter badge milestones, award conditions, or on-chain badge recording.
The referral commission decision does not affect prize-winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain verification.
The commission trigger and payout details do not change the Big Block prize amount, draw trigger, ticket lifecycle, or pool funding rules.
The commission trigger and payout details do not change the Small Block prize amount, draw interval, ticket lifecycle, or pool funding rules.
The code-used commission decision does not alter which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state transfer on resale.
Automatic wallet delivery of referral commissions is distinct from manual one-click collection of prize winnings and does not change the prize claim flow.
